P0 audit — optimized in this pass

• Header: More owns the top-right 44×44 target; Home has no status pill or master switch
• Home: native UISwitch appears only in category rows; all categories Off does not create a separate screen
• Locked Pro control: do not toggle optimistically — present Upgrade and return unchanged after cancel
• Upgrade purchase: CTA → Processing… (disabled); cancel returns silently; failure appears inline below CTA
• Restore: Restore Purchases → Restoring…; success shows Pro restored inline; no separate transaction screens
• Motion: button press 0.98 scale / 140ms; system navigation and switch motion
• Reduce Motion: remove movement and scale; retain a 160ms opacity transition for comprehension
• Accessibility: rows grow with Dynamic Type; scroll content instead of shrinking or clipping copy
• Brand #2F6A58 identifies primary action; warm gold is reserved for Pro
